_why: Hand-counted from the five steps in make_fixture.py, which is where the
numbers were chosen — not read back out of the parser. Steps 0-3 are LLM
requests; step 4 has no ModelUsageStats and must produce no record, so
records is 4 and not 5.
(ModelUsageStats field 2: the UNCACHED remainder, which
is what this column means. Total prompt would be this
plus cache_read_tokens, and is computed at render time.)
cache_read_tokens  24679 + 50000 = 74679
(steps 0 and 3 have no field 5 at all, so they
contribute nothing rather than contributing 0)
(field 3 is the output TOTAL. Steps 0, 1 and 3 also
carry its split across fields 9 and 10 -- 459+83,
146+100, 6+4 -- which sum to the same 542, 246 and 10.
Summing 3, 9 and 10 together would double-count output.)
cache_write_5m     null, and cache_write_1h null
(ModelUsageStats field 4 IS cache_write_tokens, but
Antigravity never writes it: absent in all 7,679 real
requests checked. null means unmeasured; 0 would claim
the cache writes were measured and free.)
